output.reason: The release note and PR [ev-7a52ae1356d7][ev-cad86aa8a7f1] only say that rights on applicationsets were added for the application controller. The changed files [ev-184fbf4aca2b] show this was done in the controller Role and the install manifests. Nothing says which verbs were added, what failed before the fix, or which environments ran into it. The PR points to argo-helm issue #2974 for that, but the issue text is not in the evidence. The proposed condition (ApplicationSet in use, at v1alpha1 or v1beta1) is therefore unsupported, and the v1beta1 version appears nowhere in the evidence. To decide, we need issue #2974 or the PR diff showing the added rules and the failure they fix.
